title: Signal: Dependency pinned to a placeholder zero version
scope: A package.json file that declares a pin to `0.0.0`, the placeholder version package managers publish before a real release.
limitations: It matches a pin to `0.0.0`, the placeholder version package managers publish before a real release in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A deliberately published `0.0.0` bootstrap artifact is still reported; record the exception.
